summary_en: The study tests VNX-101, a gene therapy that carries instructions for a CD3/CD19 bi-specific T-cell engager, in adults and teens with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive leukemia or lymphoma. It is given as a single intravenous (IV) infusion at one of four dose levels, which are tested in escalating order. This Phase 1/2 study looks at safety, dose-finding, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy; a specific main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: El estudio prueba VNX-101, una terapia génica que lleva instrucciones para un engager biespecífico de células T CD3/CD19, en adultos y adolescentes con leucemia o linfoma positivos para CD19 que recayeron o son refractarios. Se administra como una sola infusión intravenosa (IV) en uno de cuatro niveles de dosis, que se prueban en orden creciente. Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa la seguridad, la búsqueda de la dosis, la farmacocinética y la eficacia; no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Age 18 to 90 years (Part 1) or 13 to 90 years (Part 2)
Relapsed or refractory CD19-positive leukemia or lymphoma, as defined in the protocol
AAV antibody level within protocol-specified requirements
Kidney, liver, heart, lung, and blood count values within protocol-specified ranges
not_for: AST or ALT liver enzymes more than 2 times the upper limit of normal
History of thrombotic microangiopathy, cardiomyopathy, or sensory neuropathy
Acute GvHD grade 2 to 4, or chronic GvHD of any grade
History of hypersensitivity or toxicity related to corticosteroids; or chemotherapy within protocol-specified discontinuation timelines
